name: sup-run-fallback-subset
notes: `vdelta run`'s 2-stage default baseline resolution (issue #72) falls through to stage 2 (`previous-superset`) when stage 1 abstains `baseline-missing`: `B`'s only series-mate is the wider run `A` (selector `[]`), so stage 1 has no same-stream candidate. Stage 2 proves `A` a superset of `B` (empty selector selects the whole inventory) and wins, disclosed via `baseline.mode: 'previous-superset'` and `baseline.selection_reason: 'most-recent-maximal-proven-superset'` (not silently, per §5.3). `tests/out.test.ts` (red) falls outside `B`'s narrower selector and is disclosed via `transitions.out_of_scope`, never claimed `repaired` -- identical to `sup-single-candidate`'s `cmp` assertion, since both fixtures share the same `projects/base` seed.
